notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [March DLC] Slightly tweaked the geometry in two rooms to make the rooms clearer
[*] [March DLC] Fixed an event's timing being inconsistent

notes.title: March DLC is out now!
notes.content:
Leap Year: March continues the adventure for players who have beaten Leap Year and want an even greater challenge. To celebrate the release, Leap Year is 30% off for the next week!


[previewyoutube=IG3siSIlyuo;full][/previewyoutube]

Use the same tools you learned in Leap Year to explore another hand drawn world that’s both larger and much more complex. Master your understanding of Leap Year’s secrets to complete another month of your calendar. 

[list]
[*] About 4 more hours of playtime
[*] 50+ challenging new rooms
[*] 7 new Steam achievements
[*] A new way to die
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458170/Leap_Year_March/

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added content for March DLC (which will be available in a few hours!!)
[*] Redesigned title screen slightly to make room for DLC
[*] Added a flag and moved another in a late game area
[*] Added spikes to prevent a softlock in a late game area
[*] Fixed some inconsistencies when landing on spikes
[*] Fixed inconsistency when interacting with other characters
[*] Fixed a bug where music sometimes wouldn’t play when the game first loaded
[*] Fixed a bug where Windows display scaling could lead to inconsistent game resolutions
[*] Fixed visual bug with background particles
[*] Minor map optimizations
[/list]
